profiles.finding: Located execution chronology January 1, 1847, Darlington; no arrest or admission date established. Unrelated Tasmanian Charles Benwell alias William Powell excluded.
Execution compilation repeats September 8, 1810, Chatham; no admission date established. Georgia historical newspaper search returned internal error; primary newspaper follow-up remains open.

next_lead.finding: 1856–1857 North Carolina Public Laws, comptroller statement printed p. 113, records November 1854 payment for publication of a fugitive proclamation for Willis Hester and James Wilson. This is a publication/payment record, not arrest. Original proclamation and capture report need locating.
